translated_title: Morena's Elections Commission Chief: Differences Are Natural to a Living Party
original_title: Citlali Hernández: diferencias en Morena son naturales de un partido vivo
author: Fabiola Martínez and Jessica Xantomila
meta_description: Amid criticism over the 10 chosen profiles, Citlalli Hernández, president of Morena's National Elections Commission, said the differences are natural to a living party.
